commit_message:
refactor: one path-get read engine (path_get_core); flatten_store alias (#69)

path_get, add_path_get/add_path_access and the legacy _path_get alias now share
dol._paths_core.path_get_core. _path_get kept as alias. flatten_store added as the
unambiguous name for trans.flatten (vs paths.flatten_dict); chain_get documented as
a different operation. Behaviour-preserving.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
